fixture_checks.scope: Sparse deterministic integer fixtures and ordered products, not Gaussian ensemble sampling. Resonant finite cases check the cleared identity only.

highest_chaos_checks.scope: All nine real Gaussian coordinates of the complete N=3,p=1 model. For each homogeneous coefficient g^alpha of H^j, replacing g^alpha by its product monic Hermite polynomial gives W_j(H^j). The linear operator identities are checked on every coefficient for j=1..4 and m=1,2. This is not a test of every lower Hermite-chaos component.

Clifford_size.convention: gamma_(2i)=c_i+c_i^dagger, gamma_(2i+1)=i(c_i^dagger-c_i); {gamma_a,gamma_b}=2 delta_ab. On even Clifford strings of length ell, (D+Db)X=ell X and (D+Db)X/2=(ell/2)X. The ungraded formula is not asserted for odd strings.

exact_error_identity: (N+1-2d)[(d-R)X-(A+B)X/2] = ABX-(d-R)^2X-(N-2m+1)(B-A)X/2, A=d-D, B=d-Db, d=jp; compositions precede restriction.

arithmetic.kind: Gaussian integers stored exactly in complex128
arithmetic.rank_projectors: Exact Casimir polynomial projectors; all rank denominators cleared before comparison.

scope: Finite algebra and normalization checks only. The central strong bridge requires the separate fixed-j overlap-moment and rank-tail proof; no large-N convergence, growing-j estimate, or finite-time kernel is tested.
reproducibility: Only this new driver main was run. Output is exclusive-create; all old sources and scientific outputs remain untouched.
